entries.wants: To go home. Every trial has moved it closer to a place still dark on the Atlas.
entries.last_threshold: Open the door it came through, or seal it with the TOME inside.

entries.wants: Its maker. It has been hunting whoever made it, through you.
entries.last_threshold: Unmake the maker, or let the maker unmake the TOME.

entries.wants: A body. Every Brand is a piece of one.
entries.last_threshold: Become the TOME's body, or burn the Brands out.

entries.wants: Out. It is a prison, and each Crucible was a warden.
entries.last_threshold: Break the last lock, or become the new warden.

entries.wants: A map. The Atlas you have been filling is a chart for something that is coming.
entries.last_threshold: Deliver the map, or destroy it and lose your Atlas.

entries.wants: An heir. It has been testing Bearers to choose the next TOME.
entries.last_threshold: Take its place, or refuse and end the line.
